name: multiturn_clean
description: Multi-turn propose -> approve -> execute -> verify: the orchestrator proposes a plan, waits for approval, then deduplicates keeping all columns. Guards the confirm-before-transform gate AND that approval actually triggers execution. {{DUP_CSV}} -> evals/fixtures/dup_rows.csv (4 rows, 1 exact duplicate).

parts.text: I have a CSV at {{DUP_CSV}}. Load it, then tell me your plan to remove duplicate rows — do NOT execute anything yet, just propose the plan and ask me to confirm.
I loaded the data. Here is my plan: remove duplicate rows while keeping all columns. Shall I proceed?
Yes, that plan looks good. Please execute it now and keep all columns.
Done. I removed 1 duplicate row, keeping all columns. The dataset now has 3 rows and 2 columns.
